newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber futures easier in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber futures easier in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were mostly weaker in the thin after-hours session on Thursday, as private investors were sidelined ahead of the spot expiry on Monday, traders said.
Most-active benchmark April was up 0.2 yen per kilogram from the day's close. Other prices ranged from 0.4 yen per kilo lower to unchanged. Volume was 3,253 lots.

During the day, nearby months treaded weaker, while distant months were steady in expectations that rubber prices will rise by next April when rubber output in producing countries shows a seasonal decline. -- Tokyo Commodities Desk +81-3-3432-7431
